headline: Recreation-Work Balance, from entry to detail
overview: Weekly balance tracker for work, play, rest, social, and personal time. Monitor how you distribute your time across life's essential domains and make intentional adjustments for greater fulfillment.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Recreation-Work Balance — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the weekly balance tracker with time allocation across work, play, rest, social, and personal domains.
steps.screenshotAlt: Recreation-Work Balance landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Track weekly time across 5 life domains: work, play, rest, social, and personal
Visualize your balance profile with charts and trend data
Identify which areas are over- or under-represented in your week
Make intentional adjustments to achieve a more fulfilling balance
tips: Log your time estimates at the end of each week while the week is still fresh in your memory.
Don't aim for equal time in all areas — a meaningful balance looks different for everyone. Focus on alignment with your values.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
